limitations: The separating curve is characterized by a one-dimensional infimum and is not given in elementary closed form; minimizer uniqueness is not proved. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Independent audit has not been performed.
provenance: A sharp comparison analysis of the E4 parameter region explicitly left open in Remark 3.1 of Wang, Chu and Qiu (2010), using a hyperbolic normalization and the classical sharp power-mean bound for the identric mean.
record_title: A sharp phase boundary in the unresolved Muirhead–identric E4 region
